risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented a challenging backdrop with lower commodity prices that reduced upstream spending and impacted global revenue, declining 2% year-on-year despite strong digital growth (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "This is translating into higher demand particularly for intervention services, artificial lift, production chemicals and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Lower oil and gas commodity prices reduce customer capital expenditures and demand for SLB services

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented challenging backdrop with geopolitical uncertainty affecting operations, particularly impacting international revenue which declined 5% year-on-year, notably in Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Sub-Saharan Africa (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "Digital pretax operating margin expanded 557 basis points sequentially to 34%, reflecting improved profitability from". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions can disrupt operations and reduce customer activity in key regions

risks.title: Concurrence du marché et pression sur les prix
risks.score_rationale: Oversupplied oil market and competitive dynamics in oilfield services sector pressure pricing and market share (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "This is translating into higher demand particularly for intervention services, artificial lift, production chemicals and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Increased competition in oilfield services may reduce revenues and operating margins

risks.title: Exécution de la transformation digitale et technologique
risks.score_rationale: SLB's growth strategy depends on successful deployment and adoption of AI and digital solutions; execution risks exist in developing and commercializing these technologies at scale Citation: "The new company, SLB Capturi, combines technology portfolios, expertise, and operation platforms to support accelerated". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Failure to effectively execute digital and AI initiatives could impair competitive positioning

risks.title: Intégration de l’acquisition ChampionX
risks.score_rationale: SLB completed $4.9 billion ChampionX acquisition in Q3 2025; integration risks exist including operational consolidation, cultural alignment, and achieving synergy targets (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "Digital Integration pretax operating margin of 25% increased 710 bps year on year primarily as". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Acquisition integration challenges could impact profitability and synergy realization

risks.title: Gestion de la liquidité et de la dette
risks.score_rationale: SLB carries $9.7 billion long-term debt and $1.9 billion short-term borrowings as of December 31, 2025, requiring disciplined capital allocation (Balance Sheet, Item 8) Citation: "These charges and credits, which are summarized below, are more fully described in Note 3". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: High debt levels require careful cash flow management and may limit financial flexibility

risks.title: Upstream spending cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: 2025 saw amidst lower upstream spending a 2% revenue decline; international revenue declined 5% due to lower activity in key regions (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "Excluding this acquired business, international revenue increased 7% year over 18 year, outperforming the rate". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Cyclical nature of upstream oil and gas spending creates revenue volatility

company_description: SLB N.V. engages in the provision of technology for the energy industry worldwide. The company operates through four divisions: Digital & Integration, Reservoir Performance, Well Construction, and Production Systems. The company provides field development and hydrocarbon production, carbon management, and integration of adjacent energy systems; reservoir interpretation and data processing services for exploration data; and well construction and production improvement services and products. It also offers subsurface geology and fluids evaluation information; stimulation services to restore or enhance well productivity through hydraulic fracturing, matrix stimulation, and water treatment; and intervention services to oil and gas operators. In addition, the company offers mud logging, directional drilling, measurement-while-drilling, and logging-while-drilling services, as well as engineering support services; supplies drilling fluid systems; designs, manufactures, and markets roller cone and fixed cutter drill bits; bottom-hole-assembly and borehole enlargement technologies; well planning, well drilling, engineering, supervision, logistics, procurement, and contracting of third parti

risks_rationale_fr.0: 2025 a présenté un contexte difficile avec prix bas réduisant capex amont et impactant revenus, en baisse de 2% YoY malgré une forte croissance digital (MD&A, Item 7). Citation: "SLB s estimated future cash flows could result in impairment charges in a future period".

risks_rationale_fr.2: Marché pétrolier en surcapacité et dynamique concurrentielle dans les services pétroliers pèsent sur prix et parts de marché. (MD&A, Item 7). Citation: "SLB s estimated future cash flows could result in impairment charges in a future period".

de.risks: Ein strukturales Risiko für SLB ist die zunehmende Konkurrenz von chinesischen Unternehmen im Markt für Bohrdienstleistungen.

fr.activity: SLB fournit des technologies et des services pour l'industrie énergétique à l'échelle mondiale.
fr.products: Elle propose des services de forage, de stimulation hydraulique, de mesure en cours de forage et des pièces d'équipement comme des forets à cône roulant.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont principalement des compagnies pétrolières et gazières, ainsi que des opérateurs de champs pétroliers.
fr.edge: SLB bénéficie d'une expertise technique reconnue et d'une présence globale qui lui permettent d'offrir des solutions intégrées à grande échelle.

fr.positioning: SLB occupe une place centrale dans la chaîne de valeur des services pétroliers, couvrant la phase de planification, de construction de puits et d'optimisation de la production.
fr.tech_products: L'entreprise développe des systèmes numériques d'intégration, des technologies de performance de réservoir et des solutions de stimulation comme le fracturing hydraulique et le traitement de l'eau.
fr.moat: Son avantage concurrentiel repose sur un portefeuille de brevets, une vaste base de données d'exploration, ainsi qu'une capacité de service complet qui crée des barrières à l'entrée pour les nouveaux acteurs.
fr.risks: SLB reste exposée à la cyclicité du prix du pétrole, à la concurrence intense des autres fournisseurs de services pétroliers et à la pression réglementaire croissante sur les pratiques de fracturation et les émissions de carbone.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented a challenging backdrop with lower commodity prices that reduced upstream spending and impacted global revenue, declining 2% year-on-year despite strong digital growth (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "growth potential, pricing, the introduction of new technology, strategic M A activity, and commodity prices"
risks.summary: Lower oil and gas commodity prices reduce customer capital expenditures and demand for SLB services
risks.description: Lower oil and gas commodity prices reduce customer capital expenditures and demand for SLB services La conjoncture macroéconomique reste un facteur exogène majeur. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented challenging backdrop with geopolitical uncertainty affecting operations, particularly impacting international revenue which declined 5% year-on-year, notably in Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Sub-Saharan Africa (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "Forward-looking statements reflect management s current expectations and are inherently uncertain, and actual results or"
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions can disrupt operations and reduce customer activity in key regions
risks.description: Geopolitical tensions can disrupt operations and reduce customer activity in key regions Les tensions internationales et restrictions commerciales peuvent affecter durablement l'activité. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.

risks.title: Market competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Oversupplied oil market and competitive dynamics in oilfield services sector pressure pricing and market share (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "motivating our NEOs to outperform both our direct competitors and the broader global energy market"
risks.summary: Increased competition in oilfield services may reduce revenues and operating margins
risks.description: Increased competition in oilfield services may reduce revenues and operating margins L'arrivée de nouveaux acteurs ou l'agressivité des concurrents pèse sur les parts de marché. La tendance récente montre une intensification de ce facteur.

risks.title: Technology and digital transformation execution
risks.score_rationale: SLB's growth strategy depends on successful deployment and adoption of AI and digital solutions; execution risks exist in developing and commercializing these technologies at scale Citation: "the Energy Innovation and Technology Committee with a renewed focus on the Company s execution"
risks.summary: Failure to effectively execute digital and AI initiatives could impair competitive positioning
risks.description: Failure to effectively execute digital and AI initiatives could impair competitive positioning La dépendance à des évolutions technologiques rapides nécessite une adaptation permanente. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.

risks.title: Integration of ChampionX acquisition
risks.score_rationale: SLB completed $4.9 billion ChampionX acquisition in Q3 2025; integration risks exist including operational consolidation, cultural alignment, and achieving synergy targets (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "noted in this proxy statement do not reflect the impact of ChampionX, which was acquired"
risks.summary: Acquisition integration challenges could impact profitability and synergy realization
risks.description: Acquisition integration challenges could impact profitability and synergy realization Une défaillance opérationnelle pourrait dégrader les marges et la réputation. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.

risks.title: Liquidity and debt management
risks.score_rationale: SLB carries $9.7 billion long-term debt and $1.9 billion short-term borrowings as of December 31, 2025, requiring disciplined capital allocation (Balance Sheet, Item 8) Citation: "implementing corporate strategy in the energy industry, as well as his significant finance, capital management"
risks.summary: High debt levels require careful cash flow management and may limit financial flexibility
risks.description: High debt levels require careful cash flow management and may limit financial flexibility La qualité du portefeuille de crédit conditionne les provisions et les résultats. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.

risks.title: Upstream spending cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: 2025 saw amidst lower upstream spending a 2% revenue decline; international revenue declined 5% due to lower activity in key regions (MD&A, Item 7) Citation: "increase or decrease year-on-year, taking into account, among other things, industry cycles, anticipated customer spending"
risks.summary: Cyclical nature of upstream oil and gas spending creates revenue volatility
risks.description: Cyclical nature of upstream oil and gas spending creates revenue volatility Les enjeux opérationnels et de production restent à surveiller dans la durée. Ce facteur reste présent sans évolution majeure récente.
